data.title: Finding the Area of Polygons
data.description: Practice finding the area of various polygons plotted on a coordinate grid by using decomposition and bounding-box reasoning.

challenges.narration: A plot of land on a survey grid — find its area from the corner coordinates.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this polygon using its vertex coordinates.
challenges.hint: Count the width and height between corners. A rectangle is width × height; a right triangle is ½ × base × height.
